connector.name: Atlas by AtlasDevHQ
connector.registryDescription: Atlas is a YAML-defined semantic layer for analytics - authored by humans, consumed by AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the atlasdevhq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ATLAS_DATASOURCE_URL
env.description: Analytics datasource URL (postgres, mysql, clickhouse, snowflake, duckdb, bigquery, salesforce). Optional — falls back to a bundled NovaMart SQLite demo when unset.

env.name: ATLAS_PROVIDER
env.description: LLM provider: anthropic, openai, bedrock, ollama, openai-compatible, gateway. Optional — the MCP server does not call an LLM directly (the client does); set this only if you also run Atlas's chat or scheduler.

env.name: ATLAS_API_URL
env.description: URL of a running Atlas API. Optional — defaults to http://localhost:3001. When set, the MCP server inherits the API's connections, semantic layer, and governance.
